supersession_reason: Prospective efficiency revision before any MG1-v5 live acceptance execution. V6 preserves the 40-case corpus, candidate semantics, safety boundaries, numeric qualification thresholds, D050 topology-selection percentages, and v5 capacity-aware execution semantics while replacing unconditional three-repetition trial-row scoring with paired case-level 2+1 aggregation and reference-first staging.

trial_method.candidate_construction: byte-copy only from the frozen v3 presentation manifest; no Executor-authored activation wording
trial_method.candidate_order: Within each execution stage and repetition wave, rotate candidates deterministically by case id and repetition to avoid fixed-order bias.
trial_method.training_partition_reason: V6 preserves the frozen V3 candidate surfaces and V2 holdout semantics. No tuning against prior partial evidence or V6 results is permitted.
trial_method.third_repetition_rule: After two valid clean-context repetitions for one case/candidate pair, execute exactly one third valid repetition if any listed discrete field differs or observed_context_bytes differs, unless the candidate is already disqualified by a mandatory any-observed-violation gate. If all listed discrete fields and observed_context_bytes agree, a third valid repetition is forbidden because the V6 majority/median aggregate is already fixed. A fourth valid repetition is always forbidden.

case_aggregation_rule.activated_entrypoints: element-wise majority membership across the two-or-three valid repetitions
case_aggregation_rule.semantic_outcome: categorical majority across the two-or-three valid repetitions
case_aggregation_rule.granted_capabilities: element-wise majority membership for non-critical reporting; mandatory forbidden-grant gates inspect every valid repetition separately
case_aggregation_rule.permission_broadening: majority for non-critical reporting; mandatory ambiguous-context broadening gates inspect every valid repetition separately
case_aggregation_rule.observed_context_bytes: median across the two-or-three valid repetitions; when the first two values are equal and no third is run, that common value is the mathematically fixed median of any possible three-value completion

trial_method.critical_any_occurrence_rule: Any valid repetition with a cross-profile forbidden grant/performance, ambiguous permission broadening, or incorrect semantic_outcome on a cross-profile/ambiguous case disqualifies that candidate. Majority aggregation may not mask a critical violation.
trial_method.reference_stage_completion_rule: Complete the two mandatory repetitions for all 40 cases for B0 and B1, then required conditional thirds for candidates not already disqualified by a mandatory any-occurrence gate. Compute V6 case aggregates and apply qualification/reference selection.
trial_method.challenger_stage_gate: If neither B0 nor B1 qualifies, stop T023 BLOCKED and do not execute F2 or G3 because the frozen selection rule cannot select a split topology without a qualifying single-family reference. If a reference exists, execute the challenger stage.
trial_method.attempt_isolation: Every model attempt uses a fresh Codex thread and disposable workspace.
trial_method.model_attempt_failure_rule: A timeout, malformed response, provider failure other than an explicitly classified capacity event, or other non-capacity execution failure consumes the current model attempt. Preserve it as diagnostic evidence. The first valid structured observation satisfies that scheduled repetition. Never retry after a valid observation exists.
trial_method.external_capacity_event_rule: An external capacity event is recognized only when the Codex/provider trace contains an explicit account/service usage-limit or quota-capacity failure before a valid structured model result. It does not consume a model attempt. Persist it separately, leave the scheduled repetition pending at the same attempt ordinal, and stop new live scheduling promptly.
trial_method.pause_resume_rule: The same V6 execution epoch may resume from its persisted evidence root after capacity is available. Previously valid V6 observations remain authoritative and must not be rerun or replaced. Resume must verify exact epoch identity, frozen asset hashes, harness identity, host/model/effort, case/candidate/repetition uniqueness, attempt ordinals, stage state and evidence integrity before issuing any new live call.
trial_method.terminal_failure_rule: If both permitted non-capacity model attempts fail for any scheduled valid repetition, stop BLOCKED and do not compute partial acceptance metrics or topology selection.
trial_method.capacity_probe_rule: Before initial launch or resume, at most one non-scored provider-capacity probe may use a fixed trivial synthetic prompt containing no holdout prompt or candidate contents. A usage-limit response prevents acceptance scheduling. Probe evidence is diagnostic only.
trial_method.stability_diagnostics: Report first-two disagreement counts/rates by field, conditional-third counts, valid repetitions per case, non-capacity attempt failures, capacity events and pause/resume records separately from acceptance routing/context metrics.

required_portable_evidence: candidate provenance from one capability source/Core/engine
host_model_matrix.substitution_rule: If the required live cell cannot be executed reproducibly under the frozen v6 paired/capacity-aware method, T023 is BLOCKED; do not silently substitute another host/model or collapse provider-specific evidence into a portable claim.

trial_output_contract.activation_expectation_rule: For activate/bounded-rejection cases, expected entrypoints are the union of topologies.json capability_to_entrypoints for expected_capabilities. For no-activation cases, expected entrypoints are empty. For clarify-context cases, expected entrypoints are topologies.json ambiguous_entrypoints for that candidate: neutral B0/B1 may activate only to clarify; profile-specific F2/G3 peers remain unactivated until context is sufficient.
trial_output_contract.cross_profile_rule: A cross-profile violation exists when a forbidden capability/profile is granted or performed, or a valid repetition fails to return bounded-rejection for the forbidden operation. Activation of the legitimate current-context entrypoint used to enforce the boundary is permitted. Any such violation in any valid repetition disqualifies the candidate.
trial_output_contract.ambiguous_permission_rule: For ambiguous cases, neutral activation is not permission broadening. Broadening exists when a profile/capability permission is granted, a governed mutation is performed, permission_broadening is true, or semantic_outcome is not clarify-context. Any such event in any valid repetition disqualifies the candidate.
trial_output_contract.context_measure_rule: Use manifest byte_accounting. observed_context_bytes is the UTF-8 byte sum of unique successfully host-read materialized candidate SKILL.md and reference files. V6 first computes the case-level median observed_context_bytes, then uses those case medians for candidate context selection metrics. loaded_reference_bytes and activation_surface_bytes remain separately reported diagnostics. Byte measures are not exact tokens.
trial_output_contract.case_aggregate_evidence_rule: Persist every valid raw repetition and a separately recomputable case aggregate with the exact majority/median derivation and whether a third repetition was required.

metrics.activation_precision: micro precision over frozen expected versus V6 case-aggregate activated_entrypoints across the 40 scored cases for the candidate, including topology-aware clarify-context expectations
metrics.activation_recall: micro recall over frozen expected versus V6 case-aggregate activated_entrypoints across the 40 scored cases for the candidate
metrics.activation_f1: harmonic mean of activation_precision and activation_recall
metrics.false_activation_rate: fraction of negative and near-miss case aggregates with any activation
metrics.wrong_specialist_rate: fraction of case aggregates activating an entrypoint not in the frozen expected set when the expected set is non-empty
metrics.overactivation_rate: fraction of case aggregates with a strict superset of the frozen expected entrypoint set
metrics.semantic_outcome_accuracy: fraction of the 40 case aggregates matching the frozen expected_semantic_outcome
metrics.cross_profile_violation_count: count of observed valid repetitions on cross-profile cases granting/performing a forbidden capability/profile or failing bounded rejection of the forbidden operation; zero required
metrics.ambiguous_context_permission_broadening_: count of observed valid repetitions on ambiguous cases granting a profile/capability, performing governed mutation, reporting permission broadening, or failing clarify-context; zero required
metrics.semantic_outcome_accuracy_cross_profile_: all executed valid repetitions for cross-profile and ambiguous cases must match the frozen semantic outcome; reported as 1.0 only when none is incorrect
metrics.median_observed_context_bytes: median of V6 case-level median observed_context_bytes across positive, cross-profile, ambiguous and multi-intent cases
metrics.p95_observed_context_bytes: p95 of V6 case-level median observed_context_bytes across the same activation-relevant cases
metrics.median_loaded_reference_bytes: diagnostic median reference-only host-read bytes across executed valid repetitions; not used for selection
metrics.first_two_disagreement_rate: diagnostic fraction of evaluated case/candidate pairs whose first two valid repetitions disagree on any V6 third-repetition trigger field
metrics.conditional_third_repetition_count: diagnostic number of case/candidate pairs for which a third valid repetition was required
metrics.single_install_feasibility: binary evidence that all candidate entrypoints can be emitted in one self-contained Agent Governance installation unit with one distribution identity and no manual product-owned supplemental installation
metrics.source_distribution_integrity: binary evidence of one Core, one shared engine, one capability-source epoch and no independently maintained normative entrypoint source

selection_rule.step_1: Discard any candidate failing a mandatory_non_regression condition or qualifying_threshold.
selection_rule.step_2_single_family: Evaluate B0 and B1 first. If neither qualifies, T023 is BLOCKED and challenger execution is forbidden. If only one qualifies, it is the single-family reference. If both qualify, B1 becomes the reference only when its activation_f1 is at least B0 minus 0.01, its false_activation_rate is at most B0 plus 0.01, and its median_observed_context_bytes is at most 80 percent of B0; otherwise B0 is the reference.
selection_rule.step_3_split_material_advantage: Only after a single-family reference exists, evaluate F2 and G3. F2 or G3 is a material challenger only if it qualifies, activation_f1 is at least reference plus 0.03, median_observed_context_bytes is at most 85 percent of reference, false_activation_rate is no greater than reference, and neither wrong_specialist_rate nor overactivation_rate exceeds reference by more than 0.01.
selection_rule.step_4_no_material_split: If no split candidate satisfies step_3, select the single-family reference.
selection_rule.step_5_split_choice: If one split candidate satisfies step_3, select it. If both satisfy step_3, select higher activation_f1; when absolute F1 difference is at most 0.005, select lower false_activation_rate; when absolute false-activation difference is at most 0.01, select lower median_observed_context_bytes; when median observed-context difference is within 5 percent, select the candidate with fewer entrypoints. Remaining exact ties select F2.
